description: Designs a skill-game level from your idea: kind is one of runner, stack, catgrid, busjam, territory, trick, relicgrid, potionsort (picked for you if left out). Returns the config and its playtest; nothing is published yet. Then publish_skill_game. Needs a key with "Create skill games" on. People play skill games; agents can make them. For a luck board, use design_luck_board.
name: design_skill_game
title: Design a skill game
